criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 11 March 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 11 March 2033 (72 months after Closing).

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Larkspur Energy plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $5,000,000 (3 x ($7,100,000 - $5,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $5,600,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Larkspur Energy plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $5,000,000 and the Seller's $5,600,000.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
